result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom tab bar all render consistently. Excluding the expected partially-visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, only minor visual inconsistencies remain.

issues.description: A sliver of another category chip is visible at the right edge immediately after the 'Healthy' chip (around x=965), showing only a few pixels of the next chip. Unlike the restaurant carousel, the chip row gives almost no visual affordance that it scrolls, and the tiny sliver looks like a rendering artifact rather than an intentional peek.
issues.suggestion: Give the next chip a more deliberate peek (e.g. 24-40px visible) or add a fade/scroll indicator at the right edge so the horizontal scrollability of the filter row is clear.

issues.description: Inconsistent badge styling across cards: time badges on the 'Fastest near you' carousel use a dark-text-on-white pill, while the '€0 delivery' and '-20%' badges on the 'Popular right now' cards use green/dark text on white pills of different sizes, and the heart favorite button appears as a dark circle on one card but a brown-tinted circle on the pizza card, making the overlay treatments feel uncoordinated.
issues.suggestion: Unify overlay badge and favorite-button styles (same pill height, text color rule, and favorite-button background/opacity) across all card types.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot indicator with no textual or numeric label, and the icon itself has no visible label; the red dot on the light gray circular background is also low contrast and very small.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the bell button has an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications, unread') and make the unread indicator larger or paired with a count so its state is perceivable.
